narrative.overview: The incumbent site is a dark-mode marketing template: near-black canvas, blue→cyan gradient accents, glassmorphic bordered cards, pill CTAs, Lucide icons in gradient circles, and Framer Motion fade/slide reveals on almost every section. Typography is the browser/system sans stack — no custom display face is loaded. Atmosphere comes from animated particles, grid overlays, backdrop blur, and cyan glow shadows rather than photography or product craft. Density is medium-high: each home section repeats a centered headline + supporting sentence + card/grid pattern. Brand mark is a Zap icon in a rounded square plus gradient wordmark. The look reads as generic “AI SaaS agency 2024” more than a distinctive AorySoft identity.
keyCharacteristics: Dark gray-900 canvas with alternating gray-800/30 section bands
Single accent axis: Tailwind blue ↔ cyan gradients
Motion-first: particles, hover scale, per-section whileInView entrances
No design tokens in CSS variables; stock Tailwind 3 defaults only

rules.name: The Gradient Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Blue→cyan gradients appear on CTAs, logos, icon wells, progress, and headline accents — rarity is not part of the incumbent system.

rules.name: The Dark-Only Rule
rules.body: Public marketing UI is dark-mode only; no light theme tokens exist.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Incumbent uses a single system sans; personality is not carried by typography.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth is communicated with cyan/blue glows and blur glass, not a neutral elevation ladder.
